description: This file defines the interface for backend implementations in the torch::lazy namespace, including methods for data transfer, configuration, lowering, compilation, execution, device management, and debugging. It also declares a registrar class and functions to access backend instances and IR builder.

classes.name: BackendImplInterface
classes.description: Abstract interface for backend implementations, providing methods for initialization, data transfer, configuration, lowering, compilation, execution, device management, and debugging.

classes.name: BackendRegistrar
classes.description: Registrar class for registering backend implementations.

methods.name: InitializeAtenBindings
methods.description: Optional method to initialize ATen bindings.

methods.name: PrepareToExit
methods.description: Prepares the backend for shutdown.

methods.name: SetRngSeed
methods.description: Sets the random number generator seed.

methods.name: GetIrBuilder
methods.description: Returns the IR builder instance.

methods.name: MakeComputationDataFromTensor
methods.description: Creates backend data from a tensor.

methods.name: MakeComputationDataFromScalar
methods.description: Creates backend data from a scalar.

methods.name: CreateDataPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates a data placeholder for a given device and shape.

methods.name: GetComputationDataFromNode
methods.description: Retrieves backend data from a node.

methods.name: MakeTensorFromComputationData
methods.description: Creates a tensor from backend data.

methods.name: CreateLoweringContext
methods.description: Creates a lowering context with specified parameters.

methods.name: GetCompilationDevices
methods.description: Returns a list of devices for compilation.

methods.name: Compile
methods.description: Compiles a list of computations.

methods.name: ExecuteComputation
methods.description: Executes a computation with given arguments on a device.

methods.name: GetDefaultDeviceType
methods.description: Returns the default device type.

methods.name: SetDefaultDeviceType
methods.description: Sets the default device type.

methods.name: GetDefaultDeviceOrdinal
methods.description: Returns the default device ordinal.

methods.name: SetDefaultDeviceOrdinal
methods.description: Sets the default device ordinal.

methods.name: EagerFallbackDeviceType
methods.description: Returns the device type used for eager fallback.

methods.name: GetBackendDevices
methods.description: Returns all available backend devices.

methods.name: CreateMetricReport
methods.description: Generates a metric report string.

methods.name: GetBackendDevice
methods.description: Maps a c10::Device to a backend device.

methods.name: GetComputationBackendText
methods.description: Returns a textual description of a computation backend.
